name: zelta-steps-calories
description: Estimates calories burned, distance and time for a step count from body weight and walking pace, using METs from the Compendium of Physical Activities. Also works out how many steps it takes to walk off a calorie amount or a common Indian food such as a roti, samosa, katori of rice or dal. Estimates only, not medical advice.
